title: Clarify ARIA announcement timing, progress affordance, and micro-animation rules for button states
text:
Clarify ARIA announcement timing, progress affordance, and micro-animation rules for button states

description:
Problem: Engineers and QA have reported inconsistent ARIA live region behavior and perceived jank when button-triggered operations switch states quickly (idle -> loading -> success/error). Our current token and component rules leave too many implementation decisions to consumers which causes variability across apps and intermittent accessibility regressions.

Goal: Define a concise set of design rules that standardize (a) when and what to announce to screen readers for transient button states, (b) minimum durations and easing for micro-animations so they are perceivable but not sluggish, and (c) visual affordance choices for icon-only and compound buttons during loading/disabled transitions. The output will be a single page guideline plus a small set of token recommendations and example snippets for React/Button primitives used by engineering.

acceptance_criteria:
A single guidelines page published in Confluence with clear ARIA recommendations for live regions, announcements, and polite/assertive usage for button state changes
Minimum visible loading animation duration and suggested easing curves documented and expressed as tokens (e.g., motion.duration.button-min = 120ms, motion.easing.button-shift = cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.2,1))
Examples for icon-only and icon+label buttons showing recommended affordance (icon swap vs. inline spinner) and contrast requirements documented
Design tokens PR created with new motion and accessibility tokens and linked in the issue
Integration checklist for eng: code snippets demonstrating recommended aria-live wrapper, role updates, and guidance for debouncing announcements to avoid duplicate reads

comments:
2026-02-18 Sana Patel: Initial ticket — collected a11y bug reports from product and QA. Compiled 7 examples of inconsistent behavior from customer apps.
2026-02-22 Marco Li: Drafted a short explainer for motion minima after the design sync. Proposed 100-140ms as the perceptual sweet spot for short micro-animations; engineering asked for an upper-bound to avoid blocking throughput.
2026-02-25 Ava Martinez (ENG): Noted potential interaction with continuous batching logic — servers may return success before the UI shows a transition. Suggested we include guidance for intentional client-side minimums (visual pacing) vs. artificial delays.
2026-03-01 Liam Chen (QA): Ran accessibility smoke tests across VoiceOver and NVDA. Found duplicate announcements when network success and client-side state both triggered aria alerts. Proposed debouncing rule (200ms) and idempotent announcement keys.
2026-03-08 Design review: Reviewed 3 candidate patterns for icon-only loading affordance. Decided to prefer subtle inline spinner for critical primary actions and icon swap-to-spinner for low-frequency actions to reduce layout shift.
2026-03-11 Marco Li: Uploaded token PR and example component snippets. Requesting design sign-off on wording and interaction examples before merging.
2026-03-12 Sana Patel: Updated Confluence page with final voiceover examples and added a short QA checklist. Marking ticket ready for implementation handoff.
